description: CoLAB Claude lifecycle judges with Codex payload/output translation. Review in /hooks before activation.

hooks.command:
python3 -c "exec('import pathlib,runpy,subprocess,sys
try:
 r=pathlib.Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],text=True).strip())
 sys.argv=[str(r/'scripts/agent-bridge.py'),'codex-event']
 runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')
except Exception as e:
 print('CoLAB hook launch failed: '+str(e),file=sys.stderr)
 sys.exit(2)')"; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit 2; fi
hooks.commandWindows:
python -X utf8 -c "exec('import pathlib,runpy,subprocess,sys
try:
 r=pathlib.Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],text=True).strip())
 sys.argv=[str(r/'scripts/agent-bridge.py'),'codex-event']
 runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')
except Exception as e:
 print('CoLAB hook launch failed: '+str(e),file=sys.stderr)
 sys.exit(2)')"; if (-not $?) { exit 2 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE

hooks.command:
python3 -c "exec('import io,pathlib,runpy,subprocess,sys
try:
 raw=sys.stdin.read()
 r=pathlib.Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],text=True).strip())
 if not (r/'scripts/slack_completion.py').is_file(): print('{}'); sys.exit(0)
 sys.stdin=io.StringIO(raw)
 sys.argv=[str(r/'scripts/agent-bridge.py'),'codex-event']
 runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')
except Exception:
 print('CoLAB hook launch failed',file=sys.stderr)
 sys.exit(2)')"; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit 2; fi
